CREATE TABLE `articles` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`title` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
	`topic` text,
	`sourceUrl` text,
	`content` text NOT NULL,
	`summary` text,
	`status` enum('draft','published','archived') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `articles_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `chat_conversations` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`title` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Nova Conversa',
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `chat_conversations_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `chat_messages` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`conversationId` int NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`role` enum('user','assistant') NOT NULL,
	`content` text NOT NULL,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `chat_messages_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `generated_images` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`prompt` text NOT NULL,
	`imageUrl` text NOT NULL,
	`fileKey` varchar(512),
	`width` int DEFAULT 1024,
	`height` int DEFAULT 1024,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `generated_images_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `social_posts` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`channel` enum('instagram','linkedin','newsletter') NOT NULL,
	`title` varchar(512),
	`content` text NOT NULL,
	`imageUrl` text,
	`scheduledAt` timestamp,
	`publishedAt` timestamp,
	`status` enum('draft','scheduled','published','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
	`webhookResponse` text,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `social_posts_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `n8nWebhookUrl` text;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `n8nImageWebhookUrl` text;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `n8nArticleWebhookUrl` text;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `n8nPostWebhookUrl` text;
